description:
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Engine Motor Mounts for the Front & Rear – AKA: (Transmission Mount & Bracket)
Includes: Rear Mount Bracket & Connecting Hardware!
Made by SUZUKI
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 2 – Mounts, Front Engine
Qty 1 – Mount, Rear Engine
Qty 1 – Bracket, Mount (Rear Engine)
Qty 1 – Bolt, Lock Washer, Flat Washer
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
